claims.content: The Manager wants to gain visibility into currently available auction inventory.
Manager
The system must include an 'Inventory Import' capability so that auction inventory can be populated from an external source.
Auction inventory must have been imported from JTV's current inventory system, using inventory that meets the particular criteria for auction sale.
A product is counted in inventory numbers only if it is both 'Auction Available' AND 'Auction Eligible' in the JTV enterprise systems.
A product must be in a valid, 'sellable' physical inventory location and in the sellable realm ('white') to be included in inventory counts.
A product must have an image available in the JTV SuperNova system to be included in inventory counts.
The user must be authenticated as an Auctioneer (primary site Administrator), indicated by 'Welcome Back, Auctioneer!', to access the inventory report/management interface.
The system must have a valid date context set (e.g., to 'Tuesday, April 7, 2011') so that inventory aging and performance calculations can be generated.
The Auction Admin Main Menu page must have been opened by the Auctioneer, triggering automatic population of the 'Today's Auction Inventory Recap Section' with inventory data.
The system must be in the 'Auction Administration' module with the 'Sales Reporting' view active.
The date range filters ('Start Date' and 'End Date') must be populated or defaulted to allow report generation.
At least one grouping criterion (e.g., Retail Category, Prod Type, Gemstone) must be selected in the Group By control to structure the report output.
Auction inventory data must be populated and accessible via the 'Search for Auction Items' interface.
The system must provide a 'search for auction items' search box with wildcard (% or *) capability.
The system must provide radio button options to choose between 'Items currently online only' and 'All sellable auction inventory'.
The system must provide radio buttons to enable choosing between 'Showing items with or without images' and 'Showing items with or without a valid (sellable) location'.

The system must include a Group By scrolling list box containing grouping options such as Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Material Purity, Product Group, Brand, Inventory Realm, Inventory Aging Bucket, J/G Score, and Ring Size.
The Manager (Auctioneer) opens the Auction Admin Main Menu page, which automatically populates the 'Today's Auction Inventory Recap Section' with inventory data.
The Manager (Auctioneer) opens the Auction Admin Main Menu page to access the Auction Administration application.

The system automatically populates the 'Today's Auction Inventory Recap Section' with key inventory data (cost, units, and unique SKUs), displayed as breakdowns for 'Auction Available Inventory (Gemstones)', 'Auction Available Inventory (Jewelry)', 'Auction Available Inventory (Other)', and 'Total Auction Available Inventory'. Inventory numbers are populated only for products that are both 'Auction Available' and 'Auction Eligible', are in a valid sellable location/realm ('white'), and have an image available in the JTV SuperNova system.
The Manager accesses the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page from the Auction Admin Main Menu page via a direct link in the application navigation structure.

The system presents the report criteria section containing a 'Search for Auction Items' box with wildcard (% or *) capability, radio buttons for inventory scope ('Items currently online only' vs 'All sellable auction inventory'), and radio buttons for image/location display filters.

The Manager filters the inventory using the 'Search for Auction Items' box (with wildcard matching) and/or the multi-select scrolling list boxes for product attributes such as Retail Category, Gemstone, Product Type, Brand, Material Type, and Material Purity.
The Manager selects a radio button to choose between 'Items currently online only' and 'All sellable auction inventory'.
The Manager selects the radio-button options controlling whether items with or without images are shown, and whether items with or without a valid (sellable) location are shown.

The Manager selects one or more grouping options from the Group By scrolling list box (e.g., Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone, Material, Brand, Inventory Realm, or J/G Score) to structure the report output.
After configuring the search, scope, display, and grouping options, the Manager clicks the 'Submit' button to execute the query and generate the filtered inventory performance and aging report.

The system displays the report's Results section, with columns dynamically generated from the selected Group By choices plus fixed columns such as Product ID/SKU, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order, Buyer Name, Item Description, Retail Category, Gemstone, Product Type, Brand, J/G Score, GM/FTE, Cost, Has Image, Location, Available, Auction Available, Total QTY, White Total Qty/Cost, and Red Unsellable Total Qty/Cost.

The system displays a Summary Section below the Results table with aggregate metrics including SKU Count, SKUs with no images, SKUs with no/unavailable location, Auction Available piece count, Auction Available extended cost, and minimum/maximum Auction Available unit costs.

Diverges from Step 9: Instead of clicking 'Submit' to execute the query and generate the report, the Manager clicks 'Reset'. The system clears the selected criteria from the criteria panel, allowing the Manager to configure a new set of filters and groupings.
Diverges from Step 10: After the Results section is displayed, the Manager may optionally access the 'Analytics' section to perform deeper analysis on the displayed inventory data.

Diverges from Main Flow Step 9: If the query submitted by the Manager returns no matching inventory items, the system does not proceed to Main Flow Step 10. Instead, it displays a 'No Results Found' page (not an error state) that contains: (a) a 'Popular Searches' links section with a static list of popular gemstone searches, a separate static list of popular jewelry searches, and a dynamically updated list of search terms/phrases using Omniture data; (b) 'May We Suggest' alternative navigation links; and (c) 'Search Tips' guiding the user to check for typos, remove unnecessary words, try plural/singular forms, use fewer/generic keywords, or contact support via phone/email. Exit: The Manager may use the tips/popular searches to revise the search/filter criteria, in which case the use case returns to Main Flow Step 4; otherwise, the use case terminates with the No Results Found page displayed.

The system transitions to and displays the 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' page (or view), accessible via a direct link from the Auction Admin Main Menu, with the generated report shown on that page.

The system displays the report's Results section, with columns dynamically generated from the selected Group By choices plus fixed columns including Product ID/SKU, Active Date, Last Shown Date, Qty on Open Purchase Order (P.O.), Last Receipt Date, Buyer Name, Item Description, Retail Category, Gemstone, Product Type, Brand, J/G Score, GM/FTE, Cost, Has Image (Yes or No), Location, Available (Total Company Inventory On Hand), Auction Available (Auction Available AND Auction Eligible, with images, in sellable locations, not on any hold status), Total QTY, White Total Qty, White Total Cost, Red Unsellable Total Quantity, Red Unsellable Total Cost, Red Sellable Total Quantity, and Red Sellable Total Cost.
The report is organized according to the Manager's selected Group By criteria, so the dynamically generated columns and output rows reflect the chosen grouping structure.

The system displays a Summary Section below the Results table with aggregate metrics including SKU Count, SKUs Missing Images, SKUs with No/Unsellable Locations, Auction Available Piece Count, Auction Available Extended Cost, Auction Available Average Unit Cost, Auction Available Minimum Unit Cost, and Auction Available MAXIMUM Unit Cost (highest single unit cost).
